final.summary: Outfall pH stayed near neutral 7.2 to 7.64 during the excess flow alert, contradicting a bypass of raw alkaline wastewater. ETP power matched the inflow load and the power feed is not replayed, so aeration was not cut. Water balance shows 133.8 m3 unaccounted at the ETP boundary with outfall flow exceeding treated flow, while tank balance is within tolerance and tank level stayed flat. Conductivity fell below the case median during the excess and rose sharply when outfall flow dropped, consistent with groundwater dilution of the outfall.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
